query: SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'providerType',provider_type,'name',name,'enabled',enabled,'routingPolicy',routing_policy,'dataRetentionPolicy',data_retention_policy,'lastConnectionTestAt',last_connection_test_at,'lastConnectionTestStatus',last_connection_test_status,'version',version) ORDER BY name),'[]'::jsonb) FROM ops.provider_configs
